## PR Type & Target Branch

**PR Type:**

- [ ] `feat`: New feature / module (Target: `dev`)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (Target: `dev`)
- [ ] `hotfix`: Critical production fix (Target: `main`)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without logic changes (Target: `dev`)
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `ci`: Maintenance or documentation (Target: `dev`)

**Target Branch Check:**

- [ ] **Targeting `dev`** — Branch branched from `dev` (`feat/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`)
- [ ] **Targeting `main`** — Promoting from `dev` (or emergency `hotfix/*`)
